preconditions.description: The currency type must be either 'USD' or 'EUR'.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(values, list) and all(isinstance(x, float) for x in values)
preconditions.description: The values must be a list of floats.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, str) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output must be a list of strings.

postconditions.expression: all(x.startswith('$') if to_currency == 'USD' else x.endswith('€') for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output strings must be formatted correctly for the specified currency.
Each output string must have exactly two decimal places.
